sents.t: Today it is December, and it is snowing in Oakville for the first time this winter.
I sit by my window and think about my first six months in America.
When I arrived in June, I didn’t know anyone.
My English was not very good, and I was often nervous.
I didn’t understand Fahrenheit, yard sales, or baseball!
I found a job at Oakville Books.
I went to a baseball game and celebrated the Fourth of July, Halloween, and Thanksgiving.
And I found good friends: Rosa and Max, Emma, Carlos, Lily, and Mr. Lee.
Now I can order food, make phone calls, and talk to people in English.
I still make mistakes, but that’s OK.
I learn something new every day.
Outside, Max is playing in the snow, and Rosa waves at me.
I put on my jacket and go out.
